previousRule: Browse production coverage asserted five visible governed facets, including Colour / palette, from the clean current-production cache projection.
newRule: Browse production coverage asserts only Pattern, Texture, Character / style and Finish / sheen because their governed coverage exceeds seventy percent of the eligible catalogue; Colour remains unavailable until its coverage becomes useful.
reason: Read-only production coverage proved that visual Colour has only 3,092 known eligible fabrics (33.4%), while the four retained facets range from 71.6% to 83.0%; exposing colour now would make partial enrichment appear like an absence of eligible fabrics.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner required the smallest genuinely useful facet set, full unfiltered Browse eligibility, and unknown Fabric Knowledge to remain unknown rather than inferred or treated as false.
